title: Frank Brunner
description: "The rancor is an excellent-looking monster," observes Frank Brunner. "As a matter of fact, he's probably my favorite creature in the STAR WARS universe. I even bought the model kit!" Brunner's impressive range, encompassing lhe horrific to the absurd, is evident in this striking depiction of a Gamorrean guard feeding the ever-hungry rancor. Breaking into comics in the early '70s, Brunner is known for his hallmark work on DR. STRANGE, CONAN, HOWARD THE DUCK, and ELRIC. Recently, he rendered a number of trading cards for Topps, including JURASSIC PARK. A pioneer for creator's rights in the industry, Brunner is also one of the chief contributors to the success of the X-MEN animated T.V. series.
